title: Feedback Intelligence Agent
description: A production-style AI engineering repository that demonstrates how to build, evaluate, and serve an LLM-powered customer feedback intelligence system. The project implements an agentic RAG workflow with retrieval, evidence selection, cited responses, FastAPI serving, deterministic local fallback behavior, and offline evaluation.
